Overview.Name: Sonal Singhal
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Include non-veg mainly at dinner, avoid non-veg on Tuesday and Thursday

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (100 g) pan fried + any 1 fruit
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g)
Option 3: Plain oats (1 cup cooked) + curd
Meal_4 (Dinner - main focus): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2–3 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (100 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Tuesday and Thursday and follow vegetarian options on those days.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or chicken before eating rice.
For sweet cravings, eat fruit first and wait before taking anything extra.
Support gym training by not skipping meals and keeping protein intake consistent.
Maintain consistent routine to support thyroid balance and energy levels.
